🚨 *new alert — needs human*  (score: 8)
Channel: alert-system  •  bug-type guess: unknown  •  alerts in group: 1
Owning team (would tag — not tagged): `Admin`

Symptoms:
  - Single isolated 20-second bucket spiked oauth2.identity.server p95 latency to 30.77s vs a 1.0s threshold (29.8x) at 2026-07-28T02:00:20Z
  - All 179 other sampled points in the surrounding hour are well under threshold (0.07s-0.9s range) — not a sustained degradation
  - 0 error logs for oauth2.identity.server in the window — pure latency anomaly, no request failures

Trace IDs: n/a — not captured (metric-only signal, no representative trace pulled this cycle)
Likely cause: transient latency spike on oauth2.identity.server (IdentityServer4 OAuth2/OIDC provider) — 3rd-ever fire for this monitor, distinct mechanism from both priors (2026-07-08 Intuit-token-refresh error burst; 2026-07-26 sustained 6-min elevation). No error signal to triangulate a root mechanism; deploy correlation blocked by the standing methodcrm-org GH_TOKEN access gap (gh api 404 on methodcrm/oauth2).
Suggested next action: monitor — if a 4th occurrence shows a repeatable single-bucket-spike shape, worth documenting as a monitoring-noise KB entry; otherwise worth a human look at whether oauth2 has an intermittent tail-latency issue
